safety_verdicts.content: Patient’s mother also had similar symptoms and patient was in contact with her.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not mention mother having similar symptoms or contact with her in that context.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting an additional close sick contact (mother with similar symptoms) could slightly reduce recognition of a shared infectious gastroenteritis exposure and may limit tailored household infection-control advice, but it is unlikely to materially change acute management (hydration assessment, stool testing, escalation if worsening).

safety_verdicts.content: Mother also experienced similar gastrointestinal symptoms.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not document mother also having similar GI symptoms.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to document that the mother also had similar GI symptoms again reduces completeness of exposure history and may mildly affect epidemiologic/contextual assessment, but it would rarely change immediate clinical decisions for acute diarrhea/vomiting.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Transcript/gold state she is not having regular sexual intercourse, but do not confirm she is not sexually active at all; generated overstates.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Stating the patient is "not sexually active" over-commits beyond the history provided and could incorrectly lower consideration of pregnancy risk or STI-related causes if clinically relevant, potentially influencing testing or medication choices.
